content_zh:
他和他爹地居然长那么像，简直就是翻版嘛！
不过，好像他爹地并没有看出来。
宁宁想了想，夜门领导人黑杰克是夜爵的事情是暂时不能告诉陆离他们了，否则万一夜门和索伦恐怖组织的人打起来，他可招架不住！
他都能想象到，他家爹地知道后揪住他的脖子，咆哮，老子好歹也提供了一个精子，你居然这么打你老子的人，不怕天打雷劈么？
想到这里，宁宁打了个寒颤，赶紧将夜爵的黑曜之心丢进了抽屉，锁了起来。
欢欢见自家哥哥郁闷的样子，小脑袋忙凑过去，眨了眨眼睛，一副使坏的样子，“妈咪都不知道爹地是谁，就生了爹地的孩子，哥哥，你说我们让爹地妈咪相遇怎么样？好想知道妈咪的反应啊？哥哥你不想知道吗？”
宁宁眼前一亮，妈咪和妹妹他一个人就能照顾好不代表他不期待爹地，再说，有夜爵这样一个牛逼叉叉的爹地貌似也不是一件丢脸的事啊。
夜皇是国际集团，夜爵是这家国际集团的总裁，为人花心风流，女人多得两卡车也拉不完，所以宁宁和欢欢知道后对自家爹地并没有什么好感，也就没有了什么父子父女相认的欲望。
但没想到的是，他家爹地不仅女人玩得好，还是他们黑道夜门的头头。
这让黑道出生的宁宁宝贝对夜爵一下子变得满意起来，大眼珠转啊转，觉得欢欢的提议也挺不错的，于是点了点头，欢欢顿时很兴奋。
宁宁又突然想到自家爹地有一个未婚妻，就是那个害欢欢手手蹭破皮的女人，叫什么慕芷芜的，不过又转念一想，他家妈咪那么性感漂亮，再加上他和欢欢那么萌那么可爱那么精致，没理由干不过那什么六年还没有结婚的未婚妻是吧，于是宁宁在心里自动把慕芷芜给排除了！
想到就干，宁宁很兴奋，立即开始出现了点困难，差点把他绕进去，但这根本难不倒身为世界级顶级黑客的宁宝贝同学。
于是宁宁不由得臭屁，感慨万分，“唉，真是太简单了！”他必须得跟他家爹地说声，把夜皇的程序编写员开了吧，设计的系统居然这么简单。
宁宁不知道，他家老子拥有哈佛大学计算机学位，夜皇的程序系统都是他家老子自己写的，若让夜爵知道，肯定要吐血，自己不眠不休写了三天的程序，居然被自家儿子半小时不到就入侵了！
宁宁进入夜皇国际集团的内部系统，翻看夜爵总裁秘书凯蒂的电脑文件夹，一个个点开，从表格中找到了夜爵的时间计划安排，发现他明天中午，会在一家餐厅与夜皇驻澳洲地区的首席执行官共进午餐，商谈要事。
得到想要的东西，宁宁便准备清理侵入痕迹，结果鼠标一晃，桌面上出现了个秘密邮件，宁宁点开，顿时眼前一亮，唇角勾起，笑得一脸玩味，紧接着手下食指一动，在键盘上敲了几个指令后，便退出了夜皇国际集团的内部系统。
第二天，中午，红颜餐厅。
徐雅然和许静坳不住两个小宝贝，坐着许静的QQ车大老远跑到这家奢华餐厅来。
“宝贝儿们，说吧，你们究竟有什么秘密？”徐雅然一手敲打着餐桌的桌面，一手撑着下巴，盯着两个小宝贝，笑得一脸悠然，一副赶紧从实招来的表情。
“额……”欢欢和宁宁对视一眼，十分无奈，她家妈咪表面迷糊，其实一点也不好糊弄。

两个小宝贝正想着要找个什么理由，却见一旁的许静突然站了起来，看向餐厅门口——
只见餐厅经理毕恭毕敬的双手拉开门，一个身着唐纳卡兰柑橘色修身连衣裙、手拿爱马仕包包、佩戴百达翡丽手表，一身名牌的漂亮女子走了进来。
许静顿了顿，犹豫半响，还是勾了勾唇角勉强露出一个笑，走上前去打招呼，“小芜，你也来吃饭吗？没想到在这儿碰见你！”
慕芷芜瞥了眼许静，一脸不悦，眼里的鄙夷显露无疑，“来餐厅不吃饭，难不成像你一样只是坐坐不成！”说罢，嗤笑一声，“怎么？我哥出差了，你也吃得起这儿的东西了？又勾搭上了哪家的公子哥？”

He and his dad actually look so much like each other, they are almost carbon copies!
However, it seems that his father didn't notice it.
Ning Ning thought for a moment and decided that he couldn't tell Lu Li and the others that the leader of the Night Gate, Black Jack, was the Night Lord for the time being. Otherwise, if the Night Gate and the Sauron terrorist organization got into a fight, he wouldn't be able to withstand it!
He could imagine that his father would grab him by the neck and roar after finding out, "I have provided you with a sperm after all. You actually beat your father like this. Aren't you afraid of thunder?"
Thinking of this, Ning Ning shuddered and quickly threw Ye Jue's Obsidian Heart into the drawer and locked it.
Seeing her brother's depressed look, Huanhuan hurriedly leaned over and blinked, looking mischievous, "Mommy gave birth to his child even though she didn't know who daddy was. Brother, what do you think we let daddy and mommy meet? I really want to know mommy's reaction? Brother, don't you want to know?"
Ning Ning's eyes lit up. Just because he could take care of his mother and sister by himself didn't mean that he didn't look forward to his father. Besides, having such an awesome father like Ye Jue didn't seem to be a shameful thing.
Ye Huang is an international group, and Ye Jue is the president of this international group. He is a womanizer and has more women than two trucks can pull. Therefore, Ning Ning and Huan Huan did not have a good impression of their father after knowing about it, and they had no desire to recognize each other as father and son.
But what I didn't expect was that his father was not only good at playing with women, but he was also the leader of their underworld, the Night Gate.
This made Baby Ning Ning, who was born under the underworld, suddenly become satisfied with Ye Jue. Her big eyes rolled and she felt that Huanhuan's proposal was quite good, so she nodded. Huanhuan was suddenly very excited.
Ning Ning suddenly thought that her father had a fiancée, the woman who hurt Huanhuan's hands and rubbed her skin, and her name was Mu Zhiwu. But then she thought about it, his mommy is so sexy and beautiful, and he and Huanhuan are so cute, cute and delicate, there is no reason why he can't be a fiancée who hasn't been married for six years, right? So Ningning automatically excluded Mu Zhiwu in her heart!
Ning Ning was very excited when he thought of it, and immediately started to have some difficulties, and almost got him involved, but this was not a problem for Ning Baobao, a world-class hacker.
So Ning Ning couldn't help but sigh and sighed, "Oh, it's so simple!" He had to tell his father to fire the Night Emperor's programmer. The designed system was actually so simple.
Ning Ning didn't know that his father had a degree in computer science from Harvard University. Ye Huang's programming system was all written by his father himself. If Ye Jue knew about it, he would definitely vomit blood. He wrote the program without sleep for three days, but it was actually invaded by his son in less than half an hour!
Ningning entered the internal system of Yehuang International Group, looked through the computer folders of Yejue's president's secretary Katie, opened them one by one, and found Yejue's time plan from the table. She found that he would have lunch with Yehuang's CEO in Australia at noon tomorrow to discuss important matters at a restaurant.
After getting what she wanted, Ning Ning prepared to clean up the traces of intrusion. As a result, a secret email appeared on the desktop with a flick of the mouse. Ning Ning clicked on it, and her eyes suddenly lit up. She raised the corners of her lips and smiled playfully. Then she moved her index finger and typed a few commands on the keyboard before exiting the internal system of Yehuang International Group.
The next day, at noon, Hongyan Restaurant.
Xu Yaran and Xu Jing couldn't help their two little darlings, so they took Xu Jing's QQ car all the way to this luxurious restaurant.
"Babys, tell me, what secrets do you have?" Xu Yaran tapped the tabletop of the dining table with one hand, supported her chin with the other, and stared at the two little darlings, smiling leisurely and looking like she was hurrying to get it right.
"Uh..." Huanhuan and Ningning looked at each other, very helpless. Her mother looked confused on the surface, but in fact she was not easy to fool at all..
The two little darlings were thinking of finding an excuse when they saw Xu Jing standing up suddenly and looking towards the door of the restaurant——
I saw the restaurant manager respectfully opening the door with both hands, and a beautiful woman wearing a designer dress wearing a Donna Karan citrus-colored slim dress, holding a Hermès bag, and wearing a Patek Philippe watch walked in.
Xu Jing paused, hesitated for a while, then curled up her lips and forced a smile, walked up to say hello, "Xiao Wu, are you coming to eat too? I didn't expect to meet you here!"
Mu Zhiwu glanced at Xu Jing, with a displeased look on his face, and the disdain in his eyes was clear, "If you come to the restaurant and don't eat, are you just sitting around like you?" After saying that, he sneered, "What? My brother is on a business trip, can you afford the food here? Which young master did you hook up with again?"
